_instructions: Referral partners who send traffic to this site. Each one gets its own link — epaypos.net/<entry_path> — and every visitor who arrives that way is attributed to that partner for the next 30 days. The site itself does not change: same brand, same pages. Only where the lead lands changes.
_note_on_crm: Attribution is the CRM's own mechanism. In the CRM: add the partner under Referral Partners, then Settings > Application links > create TWO links for them — one of kind 'application' and one of kind 'lead' — with the partner attached to both. LABEL THEM WITH THE PARTNER NAME: the label is copied onto every lead as its source ('Lead form — Palm Tree Pay Tech'), which is what makes a partner lead obvious in the list. The lead is also linked to the partner record, and the note on it opens with 'Via Palm Tree Pay Tech'.
_note_on_email: A partner's leads go to the CRM only. The sales@ alert that fires for ordinary applications is deliberately skipped for partner traffic, because the partner's own team works those records in the CRM.
